item_short_desc: Rothco’s Folding Shovel is an essential tool for anyone who needs a reliable and durable shovel for rugged outdoor activities. Designed with the toughest and roughest users in mind, this compact shovel features a sturdy wood handle and a strong steel shovel body, ensuring it can withstand even the most demanding tasks. The survival shovel conveniently folds up, making it easy to store and carry, whether you’re adding it to your bug out bag, rucksack, or simply taking it along for an outdoor adventure.
description: Rothco’s Folding Shovel is an essential tool for anyone who needs a reliable and durable shovel for rugged outdoor activities. Designed with the toughest and roughest users in mind, this compact shovel features a sturdy wood handle and a strong steel shovel body, ensuring it can withstand even the most demanding tasks. The survival shovel conveniently folds up, making it easy to store and carry, whether you’re adding it to your bug out bag, rucksack, or simply taking it along for an outdoor adventure. Its open dimensions measure 23 7/8 inch x 5 3/4 inch, providing ample leverage and digging power, while its closed dimensions of 16 1/8 inch x 5 3/4 inch make it compact enough to fit into small spaces. Rothco’s Folding Shovel is built for versatility and durability, making it a must-have tool for camping, hiking, or any situation where you need a reliable digging implement.
